name: A 12-Vertex Tree Lift with a Cyclic Certified Choice
definition: Let $U=Q_3=\{0,\ldots,7\}$, take the path reduction $H=1-3-7-6$, and use the acyclic cube out-map $(7,6,1,4,3,0,5,2)$. Lift the connected complement in layer zero and apply the tree-lifting construction with lower root $6$ and free vertical-source bit zero at $3$.
properties: The resulting representation map has the directed cycle $3\to11\to15\to14\to6\to2\to3$. Flipping only the free bit at $3$ makes the map acyclic, and the expansion independently peels in the order $(9,11,15,14,0,1,4,6,2,3,7,5)$. Thus arbitrary certified free-bit choices need not preserve acyclicity, although an acyclic choice exists here.
